baseline_before_skills.diagnosis: Initial portal view rendered 18+ raw <dl> key-value dumps across Command, Insights, and HOURGLASS tabs, surfaced 30+ blanket 'UNKNOWN' strings whenever optional producers were unconfigured, lacked SHARED TOKENS v1 variables and tabular-nums alignment, and had no viewport zoom/pan/fit or 1-hop ego highlighting on the Spatial Essence Atlas.

distilled_lessons.evidence: Routing /overview, /insights, /hourglass, /atlas, and /obsidian through Munzner question-to-representation tables replaced 78 raw <dt> terms with scannable KPI strips, aligned tabular-nums data tables, visual quota bullet bars (.bullet-track/.bullet-fill/.bullet-floor-tick), a 7-stage execution pipeline stepper, and an interactive pan/zoom/fit + 1-hop ego-highlighted SVG Essence Atlas.

Static + live DOM verification in design/scripts/qa_gate.py deterministically catches raw <dl> dumps (dl_term_count > 24), blanket UNKNOWN badge spam (unknown_badge_ratio > 0.05), and missing SHARED TOKENS v1 variables before human inspection.
